system.name: MoCA (Modality-Aware Credit Assignment), drawn under the title VL-Scaler
system.one_liner: An RL framework that rewards a VLM's perception separately from its reasoning, using a blindfolded text reasoner as proxy verifier.

content.variant_note: a VLM region with two cartoon heads at the centre, a blindfolded text reasoner above and an outcome verifier at lower right, joined by pale block-arrow loops
content.argues: Bad seeing can be told from bad thinking: a blindfolded text reasoner rewards perception on its own, and the same verifier also checks outcomes.
content.subject: A VLM split into Perception and Reasoning, with a Perception Verification loop and an Outcome Verification loop through one verifier.

lessons.what_to_learn: Split a model's ability into two cartoon heads (an eye for seeing, a brain for thinking) inside one tinted region and surround it with wide pale block-arrow loops that carry the verifier's signals, each loop named by a red label; a blindfolded character makes 'cannot see' instantly readable.
lessons.suits: Conceptual overviews of reward or verification schemes where one model's abilities are separated and a few role characters give feedback.

summary: MoCA is a reinforcement-learning framework that tells bad seeing from bad thinking in a vision-language model by rewarding perception separately from reasoning. Figure 1 is an illustrated overview titled VL-Scaler. A green VLM region holds a cartoon eye-head for Perception and a brain-head for Reasoning, joined by circular Synergy arrows, with their outputs (Perception Grounding, Textual Reasoning) at the right. A blindfolded text reasoner at the top receives the user question and the grounded visual evidence along pale block arrows and returns a Perception Verification reward, while an outcome verifier at lower right feeds the same verifier through a long arrow. Icons are stock cartoon pictograms and red labels name the two loops.
summary_zh: MoCA 是把视觉语言模型的“看错”与“想错”分开奖励的强化学习框架。图一为插画式总览：绿色 VLM 区内有眼睛头像（感知）和大脑头像（推理），蒙眼文本推理者经淡蓝箭头收到问题与视觉证据并回传感知奖励，右下结果验证者复用同一验证器。
notes: No paragraph of the paper mentions the figure, so roles rest on the caption, the abstract and the figure labels. The arrow from the outcome verifier goes to the blindfolded reasoner (Same Verifier); no arrow joins Textual Reasoning to Outcome Verification, so that link is recorded as adjacency only. The grey panel with its shadow is a full-canvas bitmap and the icons are separate bitmaps; regions and block arrows are translucent vector shapes.
